## Highlights

- The Tale CLI binaries are back: v0.5.86 attaches the builds for Linux (x64 and arm64), macOS (Apple silicon and Intel) and Windows, with their checksums, which v0.5.85 lacks. [#4803](https://github.com/tale-project/tale/pull/4803) repaired the tests that stopped v0.5.85's CLI build.

## Upgrade notes

- Deploy the Tale platform and the Tale CLI together. No database migration or configuration change is required, and the API contract stays at `3.35.0`. v0.5.86 supersedes v0.5.85, which has no CLI binaries: a deployment on v0.5.84 can move straight to v0.5.86.
